provenance.hardware: Nucleo-F446RE, ST-LINK firmware V2J30M19, 3.26 V, STM32F446xx device 0x421 revision A
provenance.capture_source: JUnit properties cubeprogrammer_recording_v1 and cubeprogrammer_recovery_recording_v1 from the optional CubeProgrammer hardware recording in GitHub Actions run 36452927761.
provenance.limitations: The initial HOTPLUG flash attempt failed while erasing sector 0. Agentic HIL marked flash contents unknown and quarantined the target; its approved auto-recovery and retry then completed, verified, and reset the firmware. The transcript does not establish why the first erase failed or whether any sector was erased before refusal.
